mapper.select: SELECT st.id AS service_type_id, st.name AS service_type_name, COUNT(q.id) FILTER (WHERE q.status = 'WAITING')::integer AS waiting_count, COALESCE( ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (q.completed_at - q.started_at)) / 60) FILTER (WHERE q.started_at IS NOT NULL AND q.completed_at IS NOT NULL)), 5 )::integer AS average_processing_minutes FROM service_types st LEFT JOIN queue_tickets q ON q.service_type_id = st.id AND q.health_center_id = st.health_center_id AND q.issued_at::date = CURRENT_DATE WHERE st.health_center_id = #{healthCenterId} AND st.active = true GROUP BY st.id, st.name ORDER BY st.id
